conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
INDUSTRIAL REDOX APPLICATIONS
                                         │
         ┌───────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────┐
         ▼                               ▼                               ▼
ELECTROCHEMICAL ENERGY             METALLURGICAL EXTRACTIONS        COMMERCIAL BLEACHING
├── Galvanic / Voltaic Cells      ├── Blast Furnace Fe reduction   ├── H₂O₂ Decomposition
└── Secondary Storage Batteries   │   (Fe₂O₃ + 3CO → 2Fe + 3CO₂)  └── Chlorine / Hypochlorite
    (Lead-Acid, Li-ion)           └── Hall-Héroult Al electrolysis     bleaching of pulp/textiles
conceptBreakdown.content:
1. **Electrochemical Energy**: Primary and secondary batteries (Lead-Acid, Lithium-ion) and fuel cells convert chemical Gibbs free energy into electrical work.
2. **Metallurgy**: Blast furnace extraction of iron ($\text{Fe}_2\text{O}_3 + 3\text{CO} \rightarrow 2\text{Fe} + 3\text{CO}_2$) and Hall-Héroult electrolytic reduction of molten alumina ($\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$).
3. **Commercial Bleaching**: Hydrogen peroxide ($\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$) and bleaching powder ($\text{CaOCl}_2$) for pulp, textiles, and disinfection.

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
10 NEST TRAPS SUMMARY
1. S in H₂SO₅ is +6 (not +8).
2. F₂ cannot disproportionate.
3. KMnO₄ n=5 (acid), 3 (neutral), 1 (base).
4. FeC₂O₄ n-factor = 3.
5. Hypo n-factor = 1.
6. Fe₃O₄ average ON = +8/3 (Fe²⁺:Fe³⁺ = 1:2).
7. K₂Cr₂O₇ is oxidant in acid ONLY.
8. Neutral molecule sum ON = 0.
9. Comproportionation is reverse of disproportionation.
10. Iodometry end point: deep blue DISAPPEARS.
